description: Long Description: Stable Image Services, a comprehensive suite of thirteen specialized image editing tools from Stability AI designed to accelerate professional creative workflows.  Stable Image Services enables granular control over image editing with a range of tools designed to work with your creative process, allowing you to take a single concept from ideation to finished product with precision and flexibility. The Stable Image Inpaint service intelligently modifies images by filling in or replacing specified areas with new content based on the content of a mask image.
summary: Stable Image Services on Bedrock offer ready-to-use media generation and editing capabilities delivered through APIs. The Stable Image Inpaint service intelligently modifies images by filling in or replacing specified areas with new content based on the content of a mask image.
